Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: decorative transition artwork for an Argentine secondary-school web game, "Egresado", matching an editorial paper-and-ink visual identity. Create ONE polished wide 16:9 illustration, NOT a UI mockup. Entire canvas is a flat warm pastel yellow sticky-note paper sheet, straight rectangular edges extending to all four image boundaries, subtle paper grain. Hand-drawn graphite pencil and dark charcoal ink lines, imperfect confident sketch strokes, light crosshatching, sparse muted bottle-green details and one tiny muted red accent. NO glossy or 3D rendering, NO cast shadows, no curled corners, no surrounding desk/background, no tape, no rounded corners, no neon/lime. Object-led composition: no people or body parts. Objects clustered centrally, occupy about 70% of canvas width and 75% height, ample breathing room, readable at 360px wide. Restrained editorial illustration, not childish clipart. No watermark, no brands, no UI, no numbers, no equations, no extra labels.
Subject: Front-facing sketch of a welcoming modest Argentine secondary-school facade with entrance, simple windows, and a flagpole with the Argentine flag: three horizontal bands light blue, white, light blue and a tiny ochre sun in the center of the white band. Small hand-lettered sign above the door reads exactly SECUNDARIA. Two small shrubs. No other writing.
